create.name: Olivia Bareham
create.bio:
Olivia Bareham is a death midwife and interfaith minister based in Los Angeles. She began working as a minister of healing in the late 1980s, sitting with many people at the end of their lives, and came to see the deathbed as a place where a calm, loving space matters greatly. After caring for her own mother's body at home in 2005, she founded Sacred Crossings in 2007 to support families who want to keep a loved one at home through the vigil and funeral. In 2016 she co-founded the Sacred Crossings Alternative Funeral Home, which offers home funerals, green burial and burial at sea.

Through the Sacred Crossings Institute for Conscious Dying she trains death doulas and death midwives in four levels, from facing one's own beliefs about death to after-death body care, funeral rites and burial rituals. Classes run as live two-day webinars and as four-day in-person trainings in Los Angeles. She also hosts a free monthly online gathering, Ask the Death Midwife, for people who are dying and those caring for them, writes the blog Diary of a Death Midwife, and has published an advance death care directive booklet for planning one's own funeral wishes.

courses.title: Death Doula Training (Levels I & II), In-Person
courses.description: A four-day in-person training in Los Angeles covering the first two levels of the Sacred Crossings death doula programme. It prepares students to accompany a dying person and their family through the dying process.

courses.title: Death Midwifery Training (Levels III & IV), In-Person
courses.description: The advanced four-day in-person training in Los Angeles, covering after-death body care, home funerals, funeral rites and burial rituals. The death doula levels are a prerequisite.

courses.title: Level I - Enter The Grave - Webinar
courses.description: A two-day live online foundation course in which students look at their own fears and beliefs about death. It is the first level of the death doula training.

courses.title: Conscious Dying - Level II Webinar
courses.description: A two-day live online course on guiding and supporting a dying person and their family through the final stage of life. It is the second level of the death doula training.

free_resources.title: Ask the Death Midwife
free_resources.description: A free monthly Zoom gathering on the first Friday of each month where people who are dying, their caregivers and anyone curious can bring questions about dying, death and after-death care.
